name: Floating Flamethrower

stealth.details: +23 (expert) or DC 38 Perception check (master) to notice the pattern of the orb's trajectory

disable: three DC 40 Thievery check (legendary) checks or castings of Dispel Magic (7th rank; counteract DC 40), one each to pull out or disable the elemental cores hidden in the floating skull's right eye, left eye, and mouth
routine: (3 actions) The trap loses 1 action per turn per successful check to disable. The floating flamethrower uses its first action to release a gout of flame in a 15-foot cone that deals 4d6+4 fire damage (DC 40 basic Reflex save save), its second action to fly in a U-shape in a random direction, and its third action to release another gout of flame.

items.name: Blaze

Trigger Hao Jin signals the start of the bout

Effect The trap roars with fire and rolls initiative.

text: A floating skull of fire swoops around the arena, rotating as it weaves through the ring and releasing huge gouts of flame in random directions.
